stories.title: Escándalo en Vallecas: suspendido el Rayo-Athletic por lanzamiento masivo de aviones y pelotas de goma

en.title: Scandal in Vallecas: Rayo-Athletic suspended due to massive launching of paper planes and rubber balls
en.summary: A Liga match between Rayo Vallecano and Athletic Club was permanently suspended after repeated throwing of paper planes and rubber balls onto the pitch disrupted play. The protest by Rayo fans against management was the focus of the afternoon.

stories.title: Rafael Amargo y su pareja, detenidos por agredir a un intruso en su casa y morder a un policía

en.title: Rafael Amargo and his partner detained for assaulting an intruder in their home and biting a police officer
en.summary: Flamenco dancer Rafael Amargo and his partner Luciana Bongianino were arrested after an altercation at their Madrid home in which a National Police officer was bitten by Amargo. Neighbors had alerted police after hearing screams and sounds of blows.

stories.title: Putin informa a Trump de la postura de Irán respecto a un acuerdo de paz

en.title: Putin informs Trump of Iran's stance regarding a peace agreement
en.summary: The Russian president offered his assistance to help end the war during a meeting with the Iranian leader.

stories.title: Trump impulsa la guerra de Putin con un acuerdo de suministro de combustible para bajar los precios

en.title: Trump promotes Putin's war with fuel supply deal to lower prices
en.summary: Washington authorized operations with Russian diesel through April 2027 without announcing a Moscow counterpart commitment on Ukraine, with Zelenski claiming negotiators were used as a smokescreen.

stories.title: Las protestas contra Presa suspenden el partido entre Rayo y Athletic en Vallecas

en.title: Protests against Presa suspend Rayo vs Athletic match in Vallecas
en.summary: A football match between Rayo Vallecano and Athletic Club was suspended after fans threw hundreds of colored balls and paper airplanes onto the pitch during the team's first home game at their stadium.

stories.title: Suspendido el encuentro entre el Rayo Vallecano y el Athletic Club tras el lanzamiento de objetos desde la grada

en.title: Match between Rayo Vallecano and Athletic Club suspended following object throws from stands
en.summary: The football match was halted three times due to protests and paper airplane throws from spectators that covered the pitch in white, preventing the game from continuing.

stories.title: Rafael Amargo es detenido junto a su pareja tras una pelea con otra persona que entró en su vivienda de madrugada

en.title: Rafael Amargo detained with partner following altercation with person who entered his home early morning
en.summary: Dancer Rafael Amargo was arrested at a Madrid police station after an incident involving another person who entered his residence at night, facing charges related to assault on authority.

stories.title: Ucrania ataca una terminal petrolera en Rusia después del acuerdo entre Putin y Trump

en.title: Ukraine attacks oil terminal in Russia following agreement between Putin and Trump
en.summary: Ukraine struck a petroleum terminal in Rostov, Russia, shortly after the United States and Russia announced an agreement to supply over 300,000 tons of diesel fuel to American and global markets. The facility has storage capacity exceeding 210,000 cubic meters.

stories.title: Alcaraz, con bigote y sin complicaciones en un placentero estreno en Shanghái

en.title: Alcaraz, with mustache and without complications in a pleasant debut in Shanghai
en.summary: Alcaraz, fresh from a Tokyo victory, won his opening match in Shanghai against Cerúndolo with a double 6-3 score in just over an hour.

stories.title: Rafael Amargo y su pareja detenidos tras una pelea con otra persona que entró de madrugada en su vivienda de Madrid

en.title: Flamenco dancer Rafael Amargo and his partner arrested after a fight with someone who entered their Madrid home in the early morning
en.summary: Rafael Amargo and his partner were detained following an altercation at their Madrid residence. Amargo faces accusations of assaulting national police officers and causing injuries.

stories.title: Ucrania golpea una gran terminal petrolera rusa tras el acuerdo del diésel de Trump y Putin

en.title: Ukraine strikes a major Russian oil terminal following the diesel agreement between Trump and Putin
en.summary: Ukraine attacked a Russian oil facility as the U.S. president announced a diesel deal with Russia that the country had already been preparing to implement days earlier. A simultaneous Russian attack on Zaporizhzhia caused at least 17 deaths.

stories.title: Ucrania ataca una petrolera rusa tras el acuerdo del diésel entre Trump y Putin

en.title: Ukraine attacks a Russian oil refinery following the diesel agreement between Trump and Putin
en.summary: Ukraine conducted a nighttime attack on a Russian oil facility, downing over one hundred drones during the operation. The strike also reportedly damaged a railway bridge.

stories.title: Irlanda propone recortar un 8% el presupuesto de la UE para 2028-2034

en.title: Ireland proposes cutting 8% from EU budget for 2028-2034
en.summary: Ireland's rotating EU presidency proposed an 8% reduction to the European budget for 2028-2034, but northern European countries deemed the cut insufficient and called for deeper reductions to reach a more realistic figure.

stories.title: Miriam González (Democracia21) propone bajar los impuestos de vivienda a los menores de 35 años

en.title: Miriam González (Democracia21) proposes reducing housing taxes for under-35s
en.summary: The lawyer leading new political party Democracia21 proposed eliminating housing taxes for people under 35 years old to prevent the state from profiting at the expense of younger citizens.

stories.title: Pedro Sánchez promete "reforzar y mantener" los decretos de vivienda

en.title: Pedro Sánchez promises to "strengthen and maintain" housing decrees
en.summary: The PSOE leader and candidate for Prime Minister in the November 29 elections pledged to strengthen and uphold two housing decrees that failed to pass Congress and to honor the memory of an elderly eviction victim.

stories.title: Putin confirma el acuerdo con Trump para el suministro de crudo a EEUU y al mercado mundial

en.title: Putin confirms agreement with Trump for crude supply to the US and world market
en.summary: Russia's President Putin confirmed an agreement reached with US President Trump regarding Russian petroleum supply to American and global markets.

stories.title: JTI acelera en tabaco calentado: "En 10 años su presencia será enorme"

en.title: JTI accelerates in heated tobacco: "In 10 years its presence will be enormous"
en.summary: Japanese tobacco company JTI, which owns Camel and Winston brands, is expanding its heated tobacco business and plans to invest 4.5 billion euros through 2028 in these alternative products.
